review_scope: Exact-source review of the R3 B8 parent-cache path and profile contract; no data or execution review

checks.check: Ordered B8 parent inference and sequence reset
checks.detail: The writer batches consecutive frozen source-qualified refs, invokes canonical predict once per B8 batch, and stores each output at start+offset. Each predict call initializes fresh sequence state; chunks carry state only within that call.

checks.check: Fit-only targets and canonical row weights
checks.detail: Targets and masks are read only for fitting sequences. main_row_weights is called once per complete sequence, preserving sequence-local scaling. Evaluation target and weight columns remain zero.

checks.check: Common cache identity and batch lifetime
checks.detail: The B8 helper is included in the source/cache identity. The cleanup deletes raw_tensor and sequence views before the next batch allocation, avoiding overlap with the prior raw buffer. All arms consume the same cache.
R3 separates one-time warmup and source-open timing from projected profile work. The planned 16-fit/8-evaluation sequences per fold and twelve disposable head cells do not constitute scientific fits.

limitations: Source-only review: no Parquet data, cache payloads, labels, predictions, tests, runtime profile, scientific fit, score, or resource receipt was read or produced by this reviewer.
The profile had not started when the user stopped new compute. This receipt does not authorize restarting it; a later explicit resume and fresh resource admission are required.
decision: The exact R3 source passed the requested profile-readiness review. User stop superseded execution; profile remains unstarted and scientific fit count is zero.
